checkpoints.description: Task 'art-bosses2-v1' completed successfully.

[1/1] Gave six late-section enemies dedicated sheets instead of borrowed art plus a tint: new oracle archetype (hovering seer with scrying orb) for tide_caller and frost_oracle, new herald archetype (banner-bearing wraith) for ash_herald, new witch archetype (petal gown, pointed hat, blossom staff) for petal_witch, and dedicated hound sheets for magma_hound and cinder_hound. Enemy style count rose 35 to 41 and the sprite keys now point at the new sheets; the redundant ENEMY_TINTS entries were removed so each carries its section colour in the art. Reviewed the six previews at 2x, ran a full biome capture with zero console errors, 151 tests and 8/8 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'art-late-mobs-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: add per-biome ambient particle layers, render them through Effects, cover the profile table with unit tests, then verify all 14 biomes in the browser

impact_assessment.why: Every room shares one faint accent-tinted dust field, so the fourteen biomes read as the same air and the title backdrop has little motion.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each biome gets its own layered atmosphere - dust, spores, embers, ash, snow, petals, bubbles, fireflies or drifting void - using pooled sprites with no gameplay or save impact.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new view module and a changed Effects constructor; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: runtime-only, no persisted data; perf: about fifty extra pooled sprites.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate every biome profile in a unit test, cap counts, reuse one sprite pool, render a 14-biome screenshot sweep, and run test, lint, typecheck and build.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented the per-biome atmosphere profiles, four new particle textures, the pooled Effects field, the atmosphere unit test, and the README, Graphics, Architecture and ADR documentation

[3/3] Phase 4 green: 154 tests, lint, typecheck, build, mechanics and all 8 gates pass; 16-section Playwright sweep shows 32-48 motes per biome with the expected textures and motions and zero console errors; headless software rendering loses about 1.5 fps with the field on. checklists: passed
Task 'art-atmosphere-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: replace the player's four-point scarf with a tapered two-tail ribbon, animate hem and idle breathing, regenerate the sheets, then verify idle, walk, attack and dash at 8x and in play

impact_assessment.why: The Memory Walker's scarf is a short zigzag that reads as a cyan checkmark in every frame, and the cloak hem is static, so the character who is on screen constantly has little cloth motion.
impact_assessment.benefits: A tapered two-tail ribbon with per-frame sway, a hem trim and a breathing bob gives the hero a readable cloth silhouette and more life at gameplay scale.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; art: deterministic player sheets only, atlas keys and frame sizes stay the same.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the generator deterministic, inspect all four states at 8x, reload a live run for an in-game check, and rerun tests, typecheck, build and the eight gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Reworked the hero scarf generator into a tapered two-tail ribbon with state paths, a lit top edge, an under-tail, a soft glow and a shoulder clasp; added hem sway and breathing bob, regenerated all ten player sheets, and updated Graphics and ADR-039

[3/3] Phase 4 green: 154 tests, lint, typecheck, build, mechanics and all 8 gates pass; all ten player sheets regenerated and only the player PNGs changed; idle, walk, attack, spear and greatsword reviewed at 10x and a fresh ruins run shows the two-tail scarf with zero console errors. checklists: passed
Task 'art-hero-scarf-v2' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: give the six hunched early enemies dedicated bodies - scavenger sack and claw, bombardier bandolier and fuse, low cave crawler, beaked plague caster, chitin hive guard and skeletal archer - then regenerate and verify each in play

impact_assessment.why: Scavenger, bombardier, cave dweller, plague caster, hive guard and catacomb archer all borrow the same hunched blob body with palette and eye swaps, so the first four sections repeat one silhouette.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each early enemy gets a distinct read at gameplay scale: sack and hook, bomb bandolier and fuse hood, low wide crawler, beaked plague doctor, plated insect guard and ribbed archer with bow.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; art: deterministic enemy sheets only, frame sizes and atlas keys stay the same.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Regenerate only the affected sheets, inspect idle and attack rows at 3x, spawn each enemy in a live room, and rerun tests, build and all eight gates.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Phase 4 green: 154 tests, lint, typecheck, build, mechanics and all 8 gates pass; six enemy sheets regenerated and only those PNGs changed; all six spawned together in a live ruins room and reviewed in the full 4x4 sheets with zero console errors. checklists: passed
Task 'art-early-mobs-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: clamp the enemy walk step so all walk-row frames stay on canvas, switch the renderer from the idle workaround to the real walk row, regenerate every enemy sheet, and verify a moving room

impact_assessment.why: Every enemy walk row has blank odd frames because _enemy_common returns a full plus-or-minus one step as the body's horizontal offset, which throws the body off-canvas; the renderer works around it by replaying idle frames, so moving enemies only bob.
impact_assessment.benefits: All 41 walk rows become valid and the renderer uses them, adding a side-to-side body sway to the existing vertical bob so every moving enemy reads as walking rather than sliding.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sheets.loadEnemy now reads the walk row; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none; art: every enemy PNG regenerates, frame sizes and atlas keys stay the same.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Clamp the walk step to a small amplitude, inspect idle/walk/attack/death rows, chase a live room at two moments, and rerun tests, build and all eight gates.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Phase 4 green: 154 tests, lint, typecheck, build, mechanics and all 8 gates pass; all 41 walk rows now have four populated frames and the renderer reads them; a controlled live room with all six new early mobs chasing produced a capture with zero console errors. checklists: passed
Task 'art-enemy-walk-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan: make inventory rows click-to-equip with live stats and safe discard, switch choice cards to one-click or 1/2/3 with right-click ignored and a short arming delay, move HP/mana/XP to a bottom-center HUD panel, and enrich the level-up sound

impact_assessment.why: The inventory only reacts through small action buttons with no stat feedback, choice cards need a second confirmation and do not filter non-left input, HP and XP sit in the top-left corner away from the action, and the level-up cue is a short arpeggio.
impact_assessment.benefits: A click anywhere on a bag row equips it, live stats show the effect, discard needs a deliberate second click, choice cards take one left click or 1/2/3 with a short arming delay, the bottom center carries HP/mana/XP, and level-up gets a layered fanfare.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: inventoryScreen signature and choice input behaviour; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: UI state only, no save or simulation changes; UX: single-click cards can be misclicked, so the screen arms after a short delay and ignores right-click.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Playwright sequences for row click, button click, discard confirm, right-click and number-key choice, 1/2/3 and left-click selection, bottom HUD at 1440x900 and 1024x640, plus tests, build and all eight gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implement: inventory rows click-to-equip with live stats and armed discard, choice cards single-click with arming grace and RMB ignored, HUD vitals moved to bottom center, level-up fanfare
[3/3] Verify: 154 tests, lint, typecheck, build, mechanics, 8/8 gates; Playwright inventory/choice/HUD flows with zero console errors; checklists: passed
